<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="xJe5HL-tUzzX3A5tEd4K"> <mxGraphModel dx="7357" dy="3764" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor Operator as Main / Operator
 participant Env as env : Environment
 participant M as mission : ExplorationMission
 participant C as colony : Colony

 Operator->>Env: setCondition(DUST_STORM)
 activate Env
 Env-->>Operator: environmentCondition = DUST_STORM
 deactivate Env

 Operator->>M: startMission()
 activate M
 M->>M: submitMission()
 activate M
 M->>C: getActiveMission()
 C-->>M: null
 M->>Env: getState()
 Env-->>M: DUST_STORM
 Note over M,Env: Dust storm detected! Surface operations blocked.
 M->>M: failureReason = \"Surface operations are not allowed during a dust storm.\"
 M-->>M: false
 deactivate M

 M->>M: setStatus(FAILED)
 M->>C: addMissionToHistory(this)
 Note over M,C: Colony activeMission remains NONE
 M-->>Operator: false
 deactivate M",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
